1-open-haven-on.fd0e3f:
1. Open Haven on a device you leave running
2. Settings ▸ Relays → “Be your circle's relay”
3. Done — friends' apps find it automatically
_meta.description: Haven is a private, peer-to-peer social app for your close circle. End-to-end encrypted, no central server, no ads, no tracking. iPhone, Mac, Android, Windows, Linux.
_title: Haven — a private home for your people
a-device-you-link.561578: A device you link no longer has to hold a copy of your master key — each one runs on its own keys.
a-feed-that-exists.e9a1b1: A feed that exists to connect you, not to keep you scrolling.
a-private-home-for.a0aa8b:
A private home
for your people.
a-private-peer-to.754370: A private, peer-to-peer, end-to-end-encrypted social app for your close circle. No central server, no ads, no tracking.
a-relay-an-optional.ef4825: A relay (an optional helper) can see that some encrypted bytes passed through, but never what they say.
a-relay-handling-your.5e491a: A relay handling your IP for a moment is just how the internet works — every app you own does the same thing. The difference is that Haven's relay never logs it, never stores it, and has nothing to tie it to: no account, no name, no email, no phone.
a-smaller-kinder-internet.c056c2:
A smaller, kinder internet —
just for your people.
a-stolen-device-can.876298: A stolen device can now be locked out for real
also-shipping-out-in.40af1c: Also shipping, out in the open: the next generation of Haven's group encryption — forward secrecy and post-compromise security, on our own post-quantum cryptography (MLS-style, not a classical off-the-shelf standard). It's enabled in this release and turns on per circle once everyone's devices have updated and joined — until then a circle stays on the existing key path, and a device that falls behind reverts within one sync, so no one is ever stranded. It only ever changes which key seals your content, never whether it's encrypted. We ran our own adversarial audit first — no critical or high findings, two mediums fixed — but that's our homework, not an outside review; an independent cryptographer's review is planned. Read the design docs.
android-is-live-on.6384b9: Android is live on Google Play; Windows is live on the Microsoft Store. The Linux desktop, Steam Deck & relay builds come from the latest GitHub release — real installers, not a preview.
be-the-bridge-for.19efff: Be the bridge for your circle.
being-precise-while-a.86c019: Being precise: while a relay is moving your bytes it does see your app's key — a long random identifier — alongside your IP. It has to check that key, or a stranger could help themselves to your circle's mailbox. It can't read anything with it, and it can't turn it into your name. So the promise is never logged, never sold, never readable — not "never seen".
bring-your-circle-home.f1f40e: Bring your circle home to Haven.
built-like-a-quiet.180dd6: Built like a quiet room, not a stadium
buy-me-a-coffee.149bea: Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi
calls-conversations-and-a.29a10f: Calls, conversations, and a place that's truly yours — across every screen.
calm-by-design-no.cdc75a: Calm by design — no ads, no tracking, no engagement traps.
choose-your-own-storage.c071ae: Choose your own storage — a relay you run, or your own S3 bucket. We run no storage and hold no credentials.
circles-small-private-groups.0c0e7a: Circles — small private groups for family, close friends, a team. You choose who's in.
delete-to-free-space.34bc0e: Delete to free space, and the post stays with a placeholder you can re-download anytime — nothing is really lost.

encrypted-before-it-leaves.0022e0: Encrypted before it leaves — every photo and video is locked to your circle.
every-haven-app-can.ae0e5a: Every Haven app can be a relay: flip “Be your circle's relay” in Settings and your device quietly holds your circle's sealed messages for friends who are offline. No terminal, nothing to install.
every-post-message-photo.0935fe: Every post, message, photo, video and call is encrypted on your device before it's sent.
everything-is-still-hybrid.d2dfcf: Everything is still hybrid post-quantum — built to resist tomorrow's quantum computers, today.
film-style-filters-for.4c1ec9: Film-style filters for posts and stories, including a warm Kodak Gold look.
free-everywhere-now-on.80b578: Free, everywhere. Now on the App Store for iPhone, iPad & Mac, on Google Play for Android, on the Microsoft Store for Windows and as a direct download for Linux — no ads, no tracking, no subscription, no in-app purchases. How is it free?
free-on-every-platform.80f528: Free on every platform — no ads, no tracking, no subscription. Support future development →
friends-never-see-each.396ef4: Friends never see each other's IP when a relay is in the path — only the relay does, briefly.
group-voice-video-calls.6ba4e5: Group voice & video calls with screen sharing built in.
harder-to-break-into.184a57: Harder to break into, easier to tidy up.
haven-is-a-calm.047c38: Haven is a calm little social app just for the people you love. Share photos, stories, messages and calls — all end-to-end encrypted and peer-to-peer, with no ads and no tracking. Nothing you share ever leaves your circle.
haven-is-free-no.1a2b9b: Haven is free — no ads, no tracking, no subscription. If it earns a place in your circle, you can help fund what comes next.
haven-is-free-on.437d12: Haven is free on the App Store, Google Play and the Microsoft Store, and a free download for Linux from the latest GitHub release — no ads, no tracking, no subscription and no in-app purchases. Install it, invite your people, and it's yours.
haven-makes-no-money.5b46e0: Haven makes no money from ads, tracking, or selling your data — it holds no data to sell. No ads, no behavioral tracking, no analytics, no data harvesting.
here-s-how-haven.b57b5e: Here's how Haven keeps your life yours — what stays private, and the honest limits too.
how-a-free-app.034ac9: How a free app stays free of ads
if-someone-steals-your.89de84: If someone steals your unlocked, malware-infected device, they have your device. No app on earth fixes that.
if-you-post-a.d49a56: If you post a video with music in it, Haven asks Apple's Shazam service to name the song for a credit chip — a short audio fingerprint goes to Apple, never the video or the post. On by default; off in Settings → Song credits.
if-you-want-to.b4b4d9: If you want to hide your IP from a relay entirely, run Haven behind your own VPN, or host your own relay. We looked hard at a built-in onion/Tor mode and decided against it: Tor can't carry the kind of traffic Haven's calls and direct connections need, so it would quietly break them.
imagine-a-family-photo.562467: Imagine a family photo album and a group chat that only your people can ever open — with no company in the middle. That's Haven. The keys that lock your moments live on your phone, not on a server. Even we can't read them.
in-the-secure-enclave.376555: In the Secure Enclave on Apple devices, the OS secure store elsewhere. The only way they sync between your devices is Apple's end-to-end-encrypted iCloud Keychain, which we can't read either.
iphone-ipad-mac-on.77ff36: iPhone, iPad & Mac on the App Store; Android on Google Play; Windows on the Microsoft Store; Linux and Steam Deck straight from the latest release; a tiny relay for a Pi or server.
it-runs-reliably-in.4d5f36: It runs reliably in the background, holding messages that stay end-to-end encrypted with post-quantum cryptography it can never open — your device is a post box, not a reader.
it-s-also-the.9779ee: It's also the only model that works here: Haven runs no central servers of its own to bill anyone for — your content lives on your devices, the push relay is blind and rides a free tier, and any storage relay is one you or a friend host. So there's no monthly bill to cover and nothing to monetise you for. What Haven costs is the time to build it, and that's funded directly by the people who find it valuable.
keep-on-this-device.20b4d5: "Keep on this device" pins anything you never want swept away.
leave-a-mac-or.1a19e1: Leave a Mac or desktop app running and your whole circle gets more resilient.
made-with-care-for.6c5857: Made with care for the people you love. Haven holds no keys and keeps no copy of your content — your circle is yours alone.
music-on-posts-attach.e05aaa: Music on posts — attach a song, played through each viewer's own subscription.
nearby-sharing-pass-things.5d75c1: Nearby sharing — pass things device-to-device even with no internet at all.
no-accounts-no-profiles.1f93be: No accounts, no profiles — there's no central database of you sitting in a data center.
no-likes-to-chase.d7e96f: No likes to chase, no strangers, no algorithm deciding what you see. Just the people you actually know, in a small private circle you control.
one-app-every-device.ce3246: One app, every device — iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows and Linux.
one-command-to-install.ae63ea: One command to install, one to go live — for a Pi or server with no Haven app. No ports, no domain, no cloud required.
one-honest-limit-stays.4b9eba: One honest limit stays honest: this shrinks the key's footprint from every device to a single primary you choose. A fully compromised primary is still a full compromise — the fix for that is rolling a new identity, same as before.
photos-and-stories-with.ff350a: Photos and stories with a warm, film-style soul.
prefer-a-terminal-the.d7aa2c: Prefer a terminal? The standalone relay
see-what-s-taking.daec22: See what's taking space — a cleanup screen lists everything you've downloaded, sorted by size.
set-limits-by-age.3875e0: Set limits by age or size, on your device and on a relay you run — and auto-delete now really removes the media, not just the post.
share-photos-and-videos.59e9ff: Share photos and videos with beautiful film-style filters — including a warm Kodak Gold look — and add a song so your moment has a soundtrack, played through each viewer's own music subscription.
so-removing-a-lost.94c68b: So removing a lost or stolen device can cut it off cryptographically — from your circle's content and from the settings and contacts that sync between your devices — not just hide it.
talk-in-real-time.9bb09f: Talk in real time with voice and video calls for your whole circle, share your screen, and keep one continuous conversation — all end-to-end encrypted.
the-big-security-release.edef94: The big security release. It quietly upgrades how your devices trust each other and how your storage stays under control — automatically, circle by circle, as everyone updates. Nothing to set up, nothing lost.
the-honest-version-no.612b8f: The honest version, no fine print.
the-promise-never-logged.2d7cd1: The promise: never logged, never sold, never readable. For the full picture, read the threat model and architecture docs.
the-secret-keys-that.9ca77f: The secret keys that unlock your content stay on your own devices. We never hold them.
the-secret-keys-that.b3c983: The secret keys that unlock your content stay on your own devices — never on a server, never with us. That single fact is what makes everything else on this page true.
there-s-no-central.8a0c48: There's no central account, no profile database, no advertising ID, no analytics.
there-s-no-price.eafc5c: There's no price because nothing here needs one. Haven has no servers to pay for, so there's nothing to sell you and nothing to sell about you. Development is funded directly by the people who find it valuable — by choice, never by default.
this-turns-on-per.5882ec: This turns on per circle, once every member's devices have updated — an all-present signal, never guessed from silence. Until then a coexistence path keeps un-upgraded devices working exactly as before, so no one is ever stranded and no old message becomes unreadable.
to-deliver-bytes-to.f16f89: To deliver bytes to you, a relay briefly handles your IP address — never logged, never stored, and never tied to a name, because there isn't one.
video-is-compressed-on.023f2c: Video is compressed on posting to save space and data. Story styling — including how photos and video are framed — now looks the same on every platform. And we closed a location-metadata leak on video, so nothing about where a clip was taken rides along.
what-that-means-for.f57e18: What that means for your IP
what-your-device-is.b0ba99: What your device is actually doing
you-re-the-customer.ec379a: You're the customer, not the product.
your-master-key-stays.c0d06d: Your master key stays on one primary device plus your encrypted iCloud Keychain backup, instead of being copied everywhere.
your-own-storage-means.d809aa: “Your own storage” means a Haven relay you (or a friend) run, or your own S3 bucket (S3/R2/B2) — we hold no credentials for any of it.
